picks.rationale: An LLM-generated proof (Anthropic) of a flagship percolation-theory conjecture that a Fields Medalist predicted AI would crack — a landmark AI-in-mathematics/statistical-physics result, distinct from earlier sphere-packing/curve stories.
picks.excerpt: Days after Fields Medalist Hugo Duminil-Copin predicted it, Anthropic released an LLM-generated proof of a long-standing percolation-theory conjecture on the critical threshold.
picks.headline: AI solves a 'holy grail' problem from probability theory

picks.rationale: Chalmers closed-loop AI scientist (LLM + automated reasoning + lab robot) that hypothesises, runs and interprets yeast experiments — peer-reviewed self-driving-lab result in systems biology.
picks.excerpt: Chalmers researchers combined LLMs, automated reasoning and lab robotics into a closed-loop AI scientist that generates hypotheses, runs experiments on brewer's yeast and interprets results (J. R. Soc. Interface).
picks.headline: AI scientist autonomously generates and validates new biological discoveries

picks.rationale: Tohoku's PhysMat AI framework puts physical knowledge into materials-discovery AI so predictions become testable (Adv. Funct. Mater.); materials angle adds category spread. Swapped in for DeepMind SynthID Bio, which tripped the safety classifier mid-write.
picks.excerpt: Tohoku's PhysMat AI perspective (Adv. Funct. Mater.) builds physical knowledge into materials-discovery AI as priors, descriptors, constraints, verifiers and infrastructure.
picks.headline: Physics-grounded AI framework aims to make predictions about new materials more testable

picks.rationale: ChromAgeNet reads chromatin architecture in cheap DAPI images to call stem-cell age and screen rejuvenation drugs; open dataset + model — life-science imaging angle not covered this week.
picks.excerpt: IDIBELL/BSC's ChromAgeNet CNN reads 3D chromatin organization in DAPI-stained hematopoietic stem cell nuclei to classify young vs aged cells (77%), Aging Cell.
picks.headline: AI detects signs of aging in blood stem cells from nuclear images

picks.rationale: PNAS Nexus study maps the moral/social norms of 21 LLMs with evolutionary-game modelling of the consequences — machine-psychology angle distinct from recent memory/face-bias stories.
picks.excerpt: PNAS Nexus study probes the social norms of 21 LLMs judging cooperation with people of good or bad reputation; most drift toward 'Simple Standing'.
picks.headline: Helping 'bad' people drew disapproval from some of 21 AI models
